import json


def parse_jsonl(text):
    """Parse newline-delimited JSON text into a list of decoded values.

    Whitespace-only lines are skipped. Each nonblank line must contain a
    single valid JSON value; otherwise ValueError is raised. Handles Unicode,
    CRLF line endings, and a final line without a trailing newline.
    """
    results = []
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if line.strip() == "":
            continue
        results.append(json.loads(line))
    return results

import json
from jsonl_base import parse_jsonl

# Basic values in order
assert parse_jsonl('1\n2\n3') == [1, 2, 3]

# Whitespace-only lines skipped
assert parse_jsonl('1\n\n   \n2\n') == [1, 2]

# Unicode
assert parse_jsonl('"héllo"\n"世界"') == ["héllo", "世界"]

# CRLF
assert parse_jsonl('1\r\n2\r\n3') == [1, 2, 3]

# Final line without newline
assert parse_jsonl('1\n2') == [1, 2]

# Objects / arrays
assert parse_jsonl('{"a": 1}\n[1, 2]') == [{"a": 1}, [1, 2]]

# Duplicate keys: last wins
assert parse_jsonl('{"a": 1, "a": 2}') == [{"a": 2}]

# Malformed nonblank line raises ValueError
for bad in ['1\nnot json\n2', '{"a":}', '\n\n  bad  \n']:
    try:
        parse_jsonl(bad)
        raise AssertionError(f"expected ValueError for {bad!r}")
    except ValueError:
        pass

print("all checks passed")
